item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ravi wants to compare two objects at home to find which has more mass. He knows that the heavier object has more mass and the lighter object has less mass.

Which of Ravi's conclusions about mass is correct?

options.A: A small steel spoon has more mass than a large plastic bucket because steel is a metal.
options.B: A full water bottle feels heavier than an empty one, so the full bottle has more mass.
options.C: Two identical steel glasses have different masses because they are kept in different rooms.
options.D: A big ball of cotton has more mass than a small iron nail because the cotton ball is bigger.
